4 to intend, to mean

(2:225) لاَ يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِى أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ God will not take you to account for oaths you have uttered unintentionally, but He will take you to account for what your hearts have intended.

entries.label: ك-س-ب
entries.definitionHtml:
ك/س/ب   k–s–b to earn one’s living, to profit, to acquire; to gather, acquisition; birds of prey.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 67 times in the Qur’an:
كَسَبَ kasaba 62 times and اِكْتَسَبَ ʾiktasaba 5 times.

entries.definitionHtml:
كَسَبَ kasaba i [v. trans.]

entries.label: اِكْتَسَبَ
entries.definitionHtml:
اِكْتَسَبَ ʾiktasaba [v. VIII, trans.] to commit, to acquire a bad thing

(2:286) لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ God does not burden any soul beyond its capacity: for it is [only] that which it has gained and against it [only] that which it has committed.
